heroSummary: SJUSD schedules separate two-hour early-release windows for elementary and secondary schools. High school graduations begin May 25, secondary early releases run that week, and every school releases two hours early on the May 27 final day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does San José Unified start and end school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: San José Unified students start school on Thursday, August 6, 2026. The last day is Thursday, May 27, 2027, and the published student calendar identifies it as an early-release day for all schools. Families should confirm the final-day dismissal time with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San José Unified Spring Recess in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs from Monday, April 5 through Friday, April 9, 2027. Students return on Monday, April 12. Families should still check school communications for campus-specific activities or schedule changes around the recess.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26?
content: School starts one day earlier, on August 6; the 2025–26 school year began August 7.
The last day is two calendar days earlier, moving from May 29 to May 27.
Fall and spring recess both shift one day earlier. Fall Recess runs September 28–October 2, and Spring Recess runs April 5–9.

groups.label: Early-release dates vary by school level

groups.label: The Student and Community Calendars serve different purposes

groups.label: May 27 is the last day and an early-release day
items: SJUSD lists Thursday, May 27, as both the final student day and an all-schools early-release day.
